# Drilling Holes – Диамантено пробиване Варна

> Professional diamond drilling services in Varna, Bulgaria and the Northeast Bulgaria region. Specialized in precision hole drilling through concrete, reinforced concrete, brick, stone, and panel walls. Operating since 2023. 5.0★ rating from 16 verified Google reviews.

Drilling Holes (Диамантено пробиване) is a specialized contractor based in Varna, Bulgaria, offering diamond drilling services exclusively. The company serves customers in Varna, Dobrich, Balchik, Shumen, Devnya, Kavarna, Provadia, Aksakovo, Byala, and surrounding areas within a 100 km radius. The business focuses on quality, transparent pricing (published openly online), fast response (same day or within 24 hours), and weekend availability. Owner-operated.

## Services offered

- Diamond drilling for air conditioning and heat pump installations (Ø44–Ø132 mm typical)
- Drilling for plumbing and sewerage installations (Ø50–Ø300 mm)
- Drilling for ventilation, extraction systems, and air ducts (up to Ø300 mm)
- Drilling for electrical cables and communications (from Ø20 mm)
- Drilling through heavily reinforced concrete (depth 450 mm standard, up to 1100 mm on request)
- Drilling in brick, stone, gas concrete, and panel walls

## Technical specifications

- Diameter range: Ø20 – Ø300 mm (larger diameters on request with surcharge per 10 mm)
- Standard drilling depth: 450 mm
- Maximum drilling depth (on request): 1100 mm
- Wet diamond drilling technology (dust-free, suitable for occupied homes)

## Pricing summary

- Minimum charge: €80 per job
- Ø44–Ø102 mm: €20 per hole
- Ø112–Ø132 mm: €25 per hole
- Ø152 mm: €30 per hole
- Ø162–Ø205 mm: €40 per hole
- Ø250 mm: €50 per hole
- Ø300 mm: €60 per hole
- Above 200 mm: surcharge of €1 per additional 10 mm
- Prices exclude VAT (not VAT-registered)
- Invoices issued for all jobs
- Locations outside Varna: by individual agreement
